# Code whose changes must ship with benchmark results.
#
# A pull request that changes a file matching a pattern below must include, in its description, the
# results of the listed JMH benchmarks for the base and head commits, run on the same machine.
# `tooling/benchmark-pr.sh` works out which benchmarks a branch needs, runs them on both commits and
# prints the section to paste. See AGENTS.md, "Core performance rules".
#
# Format, one rule per line:
#   <path pattern>  <Gradle project>  <benchmark class> [<benchmark class> ...]
#
# Patterns are repository-relative: `*` matches within a path segment and `**` across segments.
# Keep this list to hot, measured code: each rule adds a benchmark run to every pull request that
# touches it.

# Toolbox hash tables
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/util/Hashtable.java            :internal-api  HashtableD1Benchmark HashtableD2Benchmark
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/util/FlatHashtable.java        :internal-api  FlatHashtableIteratorBenchmark
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/util/ConcurrentHashtable.java  :internal-api  ConcurrentHashtableFindBenchmark ConcurrentHashtableDrainBenchmark

# Tag storage
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/api/TagMap.java                :internal-api  TagMapAccessBenchmark TagMapInsertBenchmark TagMapReadThroughBenchmark
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/api/*IdStore.java              :internal-api  TagMapAccessBenchmark TagMapInsertBenchmark
internal-api/src/main/java/datadog/trace/api/HashS*.java                :internal-api  TagMapAccessBenchmark TagMapInsertBenchmark

# Span creation and serialization
dd-trace-core/src/main/java/datadog/trace/core/DDSpanContext.java       :dd-trace-core SpanCreationBenchmark SetTagBenchmark
dd-trace-core/src/main/java/datadog/trace/common/writer/ddagent/TraceMapper*.java  :dd-trace-core  TraceMapperBenchmark
